LanguageData.LP_Sub_Metamorph.label: metamorph
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Metamorph.description: Treats flesh like clay: mutable form, organic weapons (bone blade, flesh maul, viscera launcher), flesh weaving, and finally weapons that both kill and heal. Always-prepared spells by level.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Psykinetic.label: psykinetic
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Psykinetic.description: Molds telekinetic force: hauling, pushing, crushing, rebounding, and finally lifting and hurling anything.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Telepath.label: telepath
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Telepath.description: A tactician of the mind: reads minds, interrogates prisoners, distracts enemies, links allies, and finally scrambles a whole group's minds.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_PsiWarper.label: psi warper
LanguageData.LP_Sub_PsiWarper.description: Folds space: teleports, swaps places, rescues allies, places beacons, and finally moves a whole group at once.
